---
title: "World Flag Explorer"
subtitle: "Browse 254 flags and discover facts about countries and territories around the globe"
format:
  html:
    theme: cosmo
    page-layout: full
resources:
  - w2560/*.png
  - countries.json
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{=html}
<style>
  body {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f0f4ff 0%, #fdf2f8 50%, #eefaf6 100%);
    min-height: 100vh;
    font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
    color: #1e293b;
    margin: 0;
  }

  #quarto-content {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: flex-start;

  }

  main.content {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;

  }

  #title-block-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 1.75rem;
  }

  h1.title {
    font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 2.85rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1e3a8a, #6d28d9, #be185d);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
  }

  p.subtitle {
    font-size: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.15rem);
    color: #475569;
    max-width: 38rem;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* Styled Observable Inputs dropdown */
  .cell-output-display form {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    margin: 0 auto 2rem !important;
    width: 100% !important;
  }

  .cell-output-display form label {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: #334155;
    width: auto !important;
  }

  .cell-output-display form select {
    width: min(100%, 400px) !important;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #0f172a;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1.5px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  }

  .cell-output-display form select:hover,
  .cell-output-display form select:focus {
    border-color: #6366f1;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    outline: none;
  }

  /* 3-column layout: Guide Character + Flag Card + Country Info Card */
  .explorer-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 175px minmax(290px, 1fr) minmax(320px, 1.12fr);
    gap: 1.5rem;
    align-items: stretch;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* Guide character container beside the flag card */
  .guide-column {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;

    padding: 0.75rem 0.35rem;

  }

  .guide-character-wrapper {
    width: 165px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    animation: guideBobEnter 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  .guide-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    overflow: visible;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 14px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1));
    animation: guideGentleBob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;

  .guide-pointing-arm {
    transform-origin: 106px 118px;

    margin-top: 0.45rem;

  .info-card-title {
    margin: 0;

  }

  .info-label {

  .fun-fact-box {
    margin-top: 1.15rem;

    border-radius: 14px;

  .fun-fact-icon {

    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .fun-fact-content {
    display: flex;

  .fun-fact-label {
    font-size: 0.76rem;

    font-size: 0.95rem;

  @keyframes guideBobEnter {
    0% {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.95);
    }
    60% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02);
    }
    100% {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes guideGentleBob {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: translateY(0);
    }
    50% {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
    }
  }

  @keyframes guideArmWave {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: rotate(0deg);
    }
    35% {
      transform: rotate(-12deg);
    }
    70% {
      transform: rotate(6deg);
    }
  }

  @keyframes flagFadeIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(8px) scale(0.985);
    }
    to {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }
  }

  @keyframes infoSlideIn {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateX(14px);
    }
    to {

      transform: translateX(0);
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 920px) {

      padding: 0.25rem 0;

    .guide-character-wrapper {
      width: 125px;
    }
    .flag-card,
    .info-card {
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1.25rem;

    @keyframes infoSlideIn {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(12px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
  }
</style>
```

```{r}
# Pass the sorted list of flag image filenames in w2560/ to Observable JS
ojs_define(flag_files = sort(list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$")))
```

```{ojs}
// Load the external country details JSON file (including outfit details)
countryData = FileAttachment("countries.json").json()

// Combine every flag file in w2560/ with its matching country details and outfit
flagOptions = flag_files
  .map(file => {
    const code = file.replace(/\.png$/i, "");
    const info = countryData[code] || {};
    return {
      file,
      code,
      name: info.name || code.toUpperCase(),
      capital: info.capital || "N/A",
      region: info.region || "N/A",
      population: info.population || "N/A",
      languages: info.languages || "N/A",
      currency: info.currency || "N/A",
      funFact: info.funFact || "",
      outfit: info.outfit || {
        type: "flag_tunic",
        label: "National Flag Colors Tunic",
        hat: "none",
        primary: "#2563eb",
        secondary: "#dc2626",
        accent: "#fbbf24"
      }
    };
  })
  .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name))

// Helper that returns the SVG markup for the character's country-specific outfit & hat
renderGuideSVG = (outfit, countryName) => {
  const { type, primary, secondary, accent, hat } = outfit;

        <path d="M66 108 L80 138 L94 108" fill="none" stroke="${secondary}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

        <rect x="54" y="138" width="52" height="15" rx="3" fill="${secondary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.8"/>
        <line x1="55" y1="145.5" x2="105" y2="145.5" stroke="${accent}" stroke-width="3"/>

    case "hanbok":

        <polygon points="55,110 73,110 107,160 107,176 92,176 53,122" fill="${secondary}"/>
        <!-- Collar & waist trim in accent flag color -->
        <path d="M64 108 Q80 120 96 108" fill="none" stroke="${accent}" stroke-width="4.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <rect x="53" y="148" width="54" height="7" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <circle cx="92" cy="126" r="5" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      `;
      break;
  }

  // Optional respectful headwear layer (drawn above the head y=18..56)
  let hatMarkup = "";
  switch (hat) {
    case "sombrero":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M60 44 Q80 14 100 44 Z" fill="${primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <ellipse cx="80" cy="44" rx="42" ry="9" fill="${secondary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <ellipse cx="80" cy="43" rx="34" ry="4" fill="none" stroke="${accent}" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "conical":
      hatMarkup = `
        <polygon points="80,18 38,48 122,48" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <line x1="80" y1="18" x2="60" y2="48" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.2"/>
        <line x1="80" y1="18" x2="100" y2="48" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "beret":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M48 45 C46 28, 98 22, 110 39 C102 45, 58 47, 48 45 Z" fill="${primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <line x1="78" y1="28" x2="81" y2="22" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "tartan_bonnet":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M48 45 C46 28, 102 24, 110 40 C102 46, 58 47, 48 45 Z" fill="${primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="54" y="40" width="50" height="6" rx="2" fill="${secondary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <circle cx="80" cy="27" r="4.5" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "alpine":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M55 44 Q80 20 105 44 Z" fill="${primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <ellipse cx="80" cy="44" rx="31" ry="6" fill="${primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="59" y="38" width="42" height="5" rx="2" fill="${secondary}"/>
        <path d="M98 38 Q106 25 102 20" fill="none" stroke="${accent}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "fez":
      hatMarkup = `
        <polygon points="64,24 96,24 100,44 60,44" fill="${primary === '#ffffff' ? '#dc2626' : primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M80 24 Q98 26 102 38" fill="none" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "taqiyah":
    case "kufi":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M54 44 Q54 24 80 24 Q106 24 106 44 Z" fill="${secondary === '#ffffff' ? primary : secondary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="54" y="39" width="52" height="6" rx="2" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "crown_floral":
      hatMarkup = `
        <circle cx="60" cy="41" r="5.5" fill="${secondary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="73" cy="38" r="6" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="87" cy="38" r="6" fill="${primary === '#ffffff' ? '#ec4899' : primary}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
        <circle cx="100" cy="41" r="5.5" fill="${accent}" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      `;
      break;
    case "hood":
      hatMarkup = `
        <path d="M44 72 C42 30, 118 30, 116 72" fill="none" stroke="#f8fafc" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <path d="M44 72 C42 30, 118 30, 116 72" fill="none" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
      `;
      break;
    default:
      hatMarkup = "";
  }

  return html`<svg
    class="guide-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 165 225"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Friendly cartoon guide wearing ${outfit.label} for ${countryName} and pointing to the flag"
  >
    <!-- Soft ground shadow -->
    <ellipse cx="80" cy="212" rx="38" ry="7" fill="rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12)" />

    <!-- Legs & Shoes (same for every country) -->
    <rect x="64" y="176" width="11" height="28" rx="5" fill="#334155" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />
    <rect x="85" y="176" width="11" height="28" rx="5" fill="#334155" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />
    <ellipse cx="67" cy="206" rx="10" ry="5.5" fill="#1e293b" />
    <ellipse cx="93" cy="206" rx="10" ry="5.5" fill="#1e293b" />

    <!-- Left resting arm (same for every country) -->
    <path
      d="M54 114 Q36 132 42 154"
      fill="none"
      stroke="${primary}"
      stroke-width="13"
      stroke-linecap="round"
    />
    <path
      d="M54 114 Q36 132 42 154"
      fill="none"
      stroke="#1e293b"
      stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
    />
    <circle cx="42" cy="156" r="7" fill="#f6c6a5" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- Right pointing arm (points right toward the flag card & gently waves) -->
    <g class="guide-pointing-arm">
      <path
        d="M106 118 Q126 112 144 102"
        fill="none"
        stroke="${primary}"
        stroke-width="13"
        stroke-linecap="round"
      />
      <path
        d="M106 118 Q126 112 144 102"
        fill="none"
        stroke="#1e293b"
        stroke-width="2"
        stroke-linecap="round"
      />
      <!-- Hand & pointing index finger -->
      <circle cx="146" cy="101" r="6.8" fill="#f6c6a5" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />
      <line x1="150" y1="99" x2="159" y2="95" stroke="#f6c6a5" stroke-width="5.5" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="150" y1="99" x2="159" y2="95" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </g>

    <!-- Country-specific traditional or flag-colored outfit -->
    ${svg`${garmentMarkup}`}

    <!-- Neck & Round friendly head (identical across all countries) -->
    <rect x="73" y="96" width="14" height="15" rx="5" fill="#f6c6a5" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2" />
    <circle cx="80" cy="70" r="30" fill="#f6c6a5" stroke="#1e293b" stroke-width="2.2" />

    <!-- Simple hair curve -->
    <path
      d="M51 64 C52 40, 108 40, 109 64 C102 50, 58 50, 51 64 Z"
      fill="#27272a"
      stroke="#1e293b"
      stroke-width="1.8"
    />

    <!-- Friendly eyes, rosy cheeks, and warm smile -->
    <circle cx="69" cy="69" r="3.4" fill="#1e293b" />
    <circle cx="91" cy="69" r="3.4" fill="#1e293b" />
    <circle cx="70.2" cy="67.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff" />
    <circle cx="92.2" cy="67.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff" />
    <ellipse cx="62" cy="76" rx="4.5" ry="2.6" fill="#fda4af" opacity="0.7" />
    <ellipse cx="98" cy="76" rx="4.5" ry="2.6" fill="#fda4af" opacity="0.7" />
    <path
      d="M71 80 Q80 88 89 80"
      fill="none"
      stroke="#1e293b"
      stroke-width="2.4"
      stroke-linecap="round"
    />

    <!-- Optional headwear -->
    ${svg`${hatMarkup}`}
  </svg>`;
}

// Dropdown menu sorted alphabetically by full country name
viewof selected = Inputs.select(flagOptions, {
  label: "Choose a country or territory:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: flagOptions.find(d => d.file === "us.png") || flagOptions[0]
})

// Responsive 3-part layout: Cartoon Guide + Flag Card + Country Info Card
html`<div class="explorer-grid" key="${selected.code}">
  <div class="guide-column">
    <div class="guide-character-wrapper">
      ${renderGuideSVG(selected.outfit, selected.name)}
      <div class="guide-outfit-caption">${selected.outfit.label}</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="flag-card">
    <div class="flag-image-wrapper">
      <img
        class="flag-image"
        src="w2560/${selected.file}"
        alt="Flag of ${selected.name}"
      />
    </div>
    <h2 class="country-name">${selected.name}</h2>
    <span class="country-code-badge">${selected.code.toUpperCase()}</span>
  </div>

  <div class="info-card">
    <div>
      <div class="info-card-header">
        <h3 class="info-card-title">🌐 Country Profile</h3>
      </div>
      <ul class="info-list">
        <li class="info-item">
          <span class="info-icon" aria-hidden="true">🏛️</span>
          <div class="info-text">
            <span class="info-label">Capital City</span>
            <span class="info-value">${selected.capital}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="info-item">
          <span class="info-icon" aria-hidden="true">🌍</span>
          <div class="info-text">
            <span class="info-label">Continent / Region</span>
            <span class="info-value">${selected.region}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="info-item">
          <span class="info-icon" aria-hidden="true">👥</span>
          <div class="info-text">
            <span class="info-label">Approximate Population</span>
            <span class="info-value">${selected.population}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="info-item">
          <span class="info-icon" aria-hidden="true">💬</span>
          <div class="info-text">
            <span class="info-label">Official Language(s)</span>
            <span class="info-value">${selected.languages}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
        <li class="info-item">
          <span class="info-icon" aria-hidden="true">💱</span>
          <div class="info-text">
            <span class="info-label">Currency</span>
            <span class="info-value">${selected.currency}</span>
          </div>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </div>

    <div class="fun-fact-box">
      <span class="fun-fact-icon" aria-hidden="true">✨</span>
      <div class="fun-fact-content">
        <span class="fun-fact-label">Fun Fact</span>
        <p class="fun-fact-text">${selected.funFact}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>`
```
